source_of_truth: Parent roadmap 2026-05-22-001 promotes V1 from future milestone to executable child work: humans need a visual static dashboard Capability Center and agents need a read-only MCP projection over the same V0b capability status envelope.

user_journeys.name: operator-reviews-capabilities-visually
user_journeys.description: An operator opens the bundled static dashboard and sees a Capability Center page without configuring Firebase. The page shows each capability's status, ownership boundary, missing setup, and next actions.
acceptance_signals: Empty state points to dontpanic capabilities status when the state file is absent
Firebase-dashboard and Linear show actionable setup states without requiring Firebase realtime

user_journeys.name: agent-reads-capability-status-through-mcp
user_journeys.description: An agent calls a read-only MCP tool to retrieve the same capability status envelope the CLI emits, optionally narrowed to one capability.
acceptance_signals: MCP tool returns the CLI-compatible JSON shape
Unknown capability id returns a clear error
No mutating setup tool is exposed

completion_test: A fresh static dashboard render shows a Capability Center from a sample capabilities-status JSON file, while an MCP call returns the same status envelope without mutation tools or secret values. Relevant dashboard and Python tests are green and sanitization is clean.
